releaseNotes: Safe-area, DRY refactor, and Change log release. LocalWave now respects Android system-bar and display-cutout insets so the app title and top controls sit below the status area with consistent breathing room. Shared package/version helpers, system-inset/window handling, MediaStore music querying, duration formatting, and song-detail presentation were centralized to reduce duplicated implementation while keeping lifecycle and updater redundancy where isolation is operationally useful. Settings now includes a detailed Change log covering LocalWave releases back to v0.1.0, with Export change log to save the bundled history as a Markdown file using Android's document picker. MusicBrainz identification also derives the installed LocalWave version instead of using a stale hard-coded version string.
